name: Small Quench
description: Meet a faint hostile soul flicker with its opposite flicker so that both go out.

name: Pattern Glimpse
description: Glimpse the shape of an incoming soul flicker early enough to choose its answer.

name: Quiet Hold
description: Hold the soul in a still calm so that stray hostile force finds nothing to take hold of.

name: Settling Breath
description: Breathe the shaking out of a startled soul until its flame stands steady again.

name: Dull Edge
description: Take the point off a foe's soul prick with a cancelling nudge so that it lands blunt.

name: Opposing Note
description: Sound the exact opposite of a hostile soul note and cancel both in a hush.

name: Exact Opposite
description: Read a hostile soul note and return its exact opposite so that the two cancel on meeting.

name: Shape Reading
description: Read the shape of an incoming soul technique by its first beat to learn what will cancel it.

name: Soft Cancel
description: Hold a soft cancelling tone against a steady hostile pressure until the pressure thins away.

name: Level Mind
description: Level the surface of the mind so that a hostile soul wave has no crest to break upon.

name: Steady Flame
description: Steady the wavering flame of a rattled ally's soul with a patient cancelling of its flutter.

name: Cold Stop
description: Press a cold stop on a foe's rising soul technique before it has taken full form.

name: Quenching Touch
description: Lay a quenching touch on a soul affliction in an ally and cancel it as it takes root.

name: Mirror Inverse
description: Turn a hostile note upside down in the mind and send it back so it cancels itself.

name: Inverse Reading
description: Read a note and its inverse together to find the exact pitch where the two meet and fall silent.

name: Phase Hold
description: Hold the soul out of phase with a hostile tone so that its force passes by without a grip.

name: Calm Return
description: Lead a disturbed ally back to a calm soul by cancelling each tremor with its opposite.

name: Offset Nudge
description: Nudge a foe's soul technique off its beat by one count so that it fails to land true.

name: Paired Silence
description: Sound a note and its opposite together so that the pair leaves a pocket of silence.

name: Settled Soul
description: Settle the soul to utter stillness so that a hostile surge slides off and finds no purchase.

name: Calm Gauge
description: Gauge how still an ally's soul is held to learn how near it stands to breaking.

name: Rest Cancel
description: Let the soul fall to rest at the moment a hostile pulse arrives and the pulse dies unfelt.

name: Quiet Balm
description: Spread a quiet balm of stillness over the ruffled soul of an ally until the ruffling stops.

name: Stifle Pulse
description: Stifle the pulse of a foe's soul technique at its start so that it gathers no force.

name: Counter Pulse
description: Send a pulse of counter frequency out to meet a hostile soul wave and erase it.

name: Frequency Find
description: Find the frequency of an incoming soul technique by listening to the first quarter beat.

name: Counter Hold
description: Hold a steady counter frequency round the soul so that hostile force is cancelled as it arrives.

name: Frequency Ease
description: Ease a fevered soul to its true frequency by cancelling the jitter that rides upon it.

name: Beat Against
description: Beat against a droning hostile tone with the opposite drone until the pair wears to nothing.

name: Dampen Stroke
description: Dampen a foe's soul stroke at its peak so that the blow falls flat and spent.

name: Counter Cover
description: Throw the user's counter frequency over a nearby ally to cancel a hostile soul note aimed at them.

name: Cutting Silence
description: Cut a foe's soul voice short with a sudden silence so that their next technique has no start.

name: Zero Meet
description: Meet a hostile soul note at the exact zero point where force and answer sum to nothing.

name: Zero Mark
description: Mark the zero point of a hostile technique by the first stir of its force.

name: Zero Guard
description: Keep the soul poised at zero so that any hostile push reads as no push at all.

name: Zero Mend
description: Bring a troubled soul back to its zero point by cancelling the stress that bends it.

name: Zero Press
description: Press a foe's soul force down to zero for the length of one beat.

name: Zero Offset
description: Offset the leftover tail of a hostile note with its mirror so that nothing lingers in the mind.
